[h3]1. A referral system is launched to attract new players.[/h3]

We have added a new referral system to attract new players to the game. By inviting your friends to the world of Blood of Titans, you earn valuable rewards and build a tight-knit game community.

1 invitation = 10 random skin fragments
5 invitations = 150 crystals
10 invitations = An avatar for your player profile
15 invitations = A special card
